info.text:
Golf operations and the pro shop bring private clubs just 13.5% of operating revenue.
In the Club Management Association of America's 2022 Finance & Operations Report (about 440 clubs): dues 49.5%, food, drinks and events 24.7%, golf operations and pro shop 13.5%.
Public courses run on volume: Americans played a record 545 million rounds in 2024, and a new record in 2025 (National Golf Foundation).
San Diego's city courses took in over $41 million in fiscal 2025 (later city figures: about $42.3M) from 427,508 rounds. Our math: about $97-$99 a round, all-in.
Sources: CMAA Board Brief (Jan/Feb 2023), National Golf Foundation, City of San Diego Golf Division (2025).
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
